source_text: Design a compact desktop lifting box. The user should rotate an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform. The platform should lift approximately 80-100 mm and support a payload of approximately 1 kg. The mechanism should be enclosed inside the housing. The product should be safe to use, mechanically plausible, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture. Avoid obvious jamming or unstable operation.
product_intent: A compact desktop device with enclosed mechanical lifting mechanism operated manually via external hand crank to achieve vertical platform movement within specified range while supporting designated payload.
user_intent_summary: Design a compact desktop lifting box that uses an external hand crank to raise and lower an internal platform, with the platform lifting approximately 80-100 mm and supporting about 1 kg of payload.
